import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# Set paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission/"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load sample submission to ensure correct format
template_cols = None
if os.path.exists(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH):
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)
    template_cols = list(sample_df.columns)

submit_cols = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Map authors to class indices for proper classification
author_to_class = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
class_to_author = {0: "EAP", 1: "HPL", 2: "MWS"}

# Load training and test data
train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

print(f"Training set size: {len(train)}")
print(f"Test set size: {len(test)}")

# Prepare data
X_train = train["text"].values
X_test = test["text"].values
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Encode labels as integer class indices (not boolean arrays)
y_train_int = train["author"].map(author_to_class).values

# Split training data for validation (80% train, 20% val) BEFORE fitting
split_idx = int(len(X_train) * 0.8)
X_train_fold = X_train[:split_idx]
X_val_fold = X_train[split_idx:]
y_train_int = y_train_int[:split_idx]
y_val_int = y_train_int[split_idx:]

# Build pipeline with logistic regression for multinomial classification
pipeline = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "tfidf",
            TfidfVectorizer(
                lowercase=True, stop_words=None, ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=5000
            ),
        ),
        (
            "clf",
            LogisticRegression(
                random_state=42,
                max_iter=1000,
                solver="lbfgs",
                multi_class="multinomial",
                n_jobs=-1,
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

# Fit model on training fold only (never touch validation data)
print("Training model...")
pipeline.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_int)

# Validate on hold-out portion that model never saw
val_probs = pipeline.predict_proba(X_val_fold)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_int, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Log-Loss (Hold-out): {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set (truly unlabeled data)
test_probs = pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission file with correct columns and format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save to required location
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)

# Final print out just the validation metric
print("\n=== EVALUATION METRICS ===")
print(f"Validation Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")
